source_note: The 82 GP01 technical snapshot files remain byte-identical to the baseline commit. GP05 carries forward the measurement clarifications, plate-only machining requirement, GP04 STEP inspection and exact candidate file guide, and adds the preference for evidence reconciliation and supported working approximations before new measurements. Prompt, brief and PDF state the current requirements. Later software maintenance is not pulled into the snapshot.
